messages:
maria: Quick sync  final preflight for Fridays announcement. Need public changelog link, canonical docs URL, one-line benchmark blurb for hero, locked webinar CTA, and an exact canary start time so we can schedule mailers. @aj @noah @sara

aj: Changelog draft is ready; will publish the public page by 18:00 PT and post link here. Small MD nit left.

noah: Docs merged to main. Ops needs to flip the redirect to make canonical: https://docs.redwood.inference/release/2027-02. Ops, can you do 08:15 PT?

ops-lead: We can flip at 08:15 PT and monitor for 20m. Canary plan: 08:25 PT 10% for 15m, 30% for 20m, full roll at 09:05 PT. Rollback triggers: p95 > 300ms or errors > 1% sustained 3m. I'll schedule via deploy-bot.

sara: CTA option: "Join our 2/18 webinar to see the benchmarks". Locking that now so designer can finish hero. Need benchmark blurb too.

maria: For the hero, keep it tight and defensible. Draft: "Up to 2.8x faster p95 and notable cost reductions on common chat loads." Good?

aj: Good to me. I'll add a short appendix to the changelog with the harness and seed prompts for reproducibility. Public changelog link will include that artifact.

noah: For lead routing, landing path = /r/feb_release, UTM: utm_campaign=feb_release&utm_source=email&utm_medium=announce. Segment event: "release_feb_signup". Sample payload I'll paste into the landing page.

deploy-bot: [scheduled] docs-redirect job queued for 2027-02-18T15:15:00Z (08:15 PT). canary-rollout job queued for 2027-02-18T15:25:00Z (08:25 PT). Monitoring hooks enabled.

maria: Final checklist: changelog link by 18:00 (aj), docs canonical flip 08:15 (ops), CTA locked (sara), benchmark blurb (maria/aj), canary plan (ops), Segment payload (noah). If all confirmed, marketing schedules email at 09:30 PT and social at 09:45 PT as long as canary is green.

aj: Confirmed, changelog publish on track.

noah: Confirmed, will paste Segment payload and landing details.

sara: Confirmed, dropping final email draft at 14:00 for quick review.

ops-lead: Confirmed, I'll post canary status updates in this thread during rollout.

maria: Thanks team  tag me if anything changes. :rocket:
